metrics.problem: How does Woven Mind relate to cognitive states?
metrics.solution: Loom's surprise detection maps to FOCUSED→DRIFTING→LOST. surprise<0.2=FOCUSED, 0.2-0.3=DRIFTING, >0.3=trigger SLOW mode (recovery)
